name: Redemption/Temptation
body:
School enchantment [mind-affecting]; Level cleric 7, inquisitor 6, oracle 7

CASTING

Casting Time 1 hour
Components V, S, M (burning incense), DF

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Will partial (see text); Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

This works as the “redemption or temptation” part of the atonement spell, except you forcefully warp the target’s mind to adjust to your alignment. The target does not need to be willing, but has to be present for the entire casting of the spell. Upon completion of the spell, the target must succeed at a Will save or change its alignment to exactly match yours and take 2d6 points of Charisma drain. A successful save negates the alignment change and changes Charisma drain to Charisma damage. Any alignment alteration resulting from this spell is mental as well as moral, and the individual changed by the magic thoroughly enjoys his new outlook. Only a wish, a miracle, a psychic surgery or the atonement spell can restore a character’s former alignment, and the affected individual does not make any attempt to return to the former alignment. In fact, he views the prospect with horror and avoids it in any way possible.

This spell doesn’t work on mindless creatures, outsiders and creatures with an alignment subtype.
